themes_detail.label: Litter basket crisis explodes
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests spiked to 4 complaints this week compared to a 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 3,100% increase (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting a sudden systemic failure in waste infrastructure or removal that emerged THIS WEEK and requires immediate investigation into sanitation department responsiveness.
evidence: 4 litter basket complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (3,100% spike)
Z-score of 11.72 indicates statistically extreme anomaly
Aligns with recurring CB budget request for new equipment for Parks maintenance, suggesting chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation and Parks departments on what caused the sudden spike—equipment failure, staffing shortage, or service reduction?
Canvass Williamsbridge/Baychester neighborhoods to document overflow and public health impacts from overflowing baskets

themes_detail.label: Vendor enforcement surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 4 this week versus a 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 967% increase (z-score: 5.21)—indicating a new crack-down or emerging street vending dispute in the district THIS WEEK.
evidence: 4 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% spike)
Z-score of 5.21 represents significant statistical anomaly
Emergence THIS WEEK suggests new policy enforcement, targeting, or conflict
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD and Department of Consumer Affairs to identify what triggered the enforcement push this week—new citywide directive or local complaints?
Interview street vendors and local merchant associations to understand their perspective on the surge

themes_detail.label: Garbage collection collapse
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints spiked to 36 over 2 weeks ago compared to a 6.0 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 500% increase (z-score: 4.56)—indicating a significant sanitation service failure 2 weeks ago that aligns with the current litter basket spike.
evidence: 36 missed collection complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 6.0 weekly average (500% spike)
Z-score of 4.56 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Convergence with current litter basket crisis suggests ongoing sanitation infrastructure breakdown
reporting_angles: Investigate whether Sanitation Department faced staffing shortages, vehicle breakdowns, or service reductions 2 weeks ago
Interview residents about how missed collections cascaded into current overflow and pest issues
Request Sanitation Department service logs and complaint resolution data for the district

themes_detail.label: Drug activity spike in Baychester
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 13 two weeks ago versus a 3.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 285% increase (z-score: 4.82)—flagging a potential public safety concern or enforcement focus in the district 2 weeks ago.
evidence: 13 drug activity complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 3.4 weekly average (285% spike)
Z-score of 4.82 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Converges with timing of missed collection crisis, suggesting possible deterioration in district conditions
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about what drove the spike—new trafficking activity, enforcement initiative, or resident reporting surge?
Speak with community organizations and residents about street-level conditions and whether conditions have worsened
Cross-reference with any new development or rezoning activity (Wakefield Village, 3901 White Plains Road) that might disrupt neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards uptick
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints spiked to 3 two weeks ago versus a 0.6 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 380% increase (z-score: 4.91)—suggesting emerging building safety risks or aging infrastructure problems in the district 2 weeks ago.
evidence: 3 electrical complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% spike)
Z-score of 4.91 indicates statistically significant anomaly
493 building alteration permits filed in past 90 days suggest active construction that may be exposing electrical issues
reporting_angles: Contact DOB to identify which electrical complaints were filed and whether they relate to active construction or pre-existing conditions
Interview building owners and electricians about whether aging infrastructure in the district is causing problems during renovation activity
